# QRco.au

> QRco.au is an Australian QR code, barcode, short-link, Smart Page, and campaign analytics platform for small businesses, tradies, agencies, teams, and enterprise rollout workflows.

QRco.au helps users create static and dynamic QR codes, generate barcodes, build QR-powered Smart Pages, manage branded short links, use custom domains, track scans, capture leads, and operate QR campaigns across Australian locations. Plans include a free tier plus paid PRO and Enterprise tiers with higher limits, teams, API access, custom domains, analytics retention, and export options.

## Crawl Notes

- Updated from a live crawl of `https://www.qrco.au/sitemap.xml` and same-domain public links on 2026-06-16.
- Sitemap URLs discovered: 386. Public HTML pages fetched successfully and included: 404.
- Excludes robots-disallowed areas such as `/dashboard/`, `/api/`, `/admin/`, `/login/`, `/register/`, and `/includes/`, plus non-HTML feeds, broken links, and account-only entry points.
- Primary support contact: support@qrco.au.
